key.name: open-on-hover
key.summary: Open the notch when the pointer rests on it

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: How long the pointer must rest on the notch before it opens, in milliseconds

key.name: closed-width
key.summary: Width of the closed notch, in pixels

key.name: size
key.summary: Size of the notch and everything in it, as a multiple of the normal size

key.name: clock-mode
key.summary: Where the top bar clock goes: inside the notch, moved to the right, or left alone

key.name: replace-osd
key.summary: Show volume and brightness changes in the notch instead of the GNOME popup

key.name: show-battery-activity
key.summary: Show a battery peek when a charger is plugged in or removed

key.name: notifications-in-notch
key.summary: Show new notifications in the notch instead of as GNOME banners

key.name: show-downloads
key.summary: Show browser downloads in the notch

key.name: show-visualizer
key.summary: Animate the music bars in the closed notch while something plays
